notes.title: Update v0.020
notes.content: This is a crazy update that has taken almost 2 months. The game has had a major overhaul underneath the skin. It went from a more arcadie style of gameplay to more of a simulation style, at least under the hood so to speak. There has also been major changes in the timing system to allow bracket racing and a more fluid online experience when it returns. Keybinds are currently the same as before but this update allows me to actually allow users to set there own in yet another update that will happen. There is only 1 car per body style at the moment. Once I feel more comfortable that things are where they are, there are a ton of new vehicles to get in. You will notice a lot of changes and features temporarily removed.
